environment: Local synthetic account on a real PostgreSQL database with migrations 001 through 005 applied.

assertions.claim: Confirmed temporal state compiles into a published immutable relationship-context Wiki.
The bounded compiler emits exactly one current dependency and one next action when all required facts are confirmed.
Every active block retains governed dependencies.
Repeating the same compilation idempotency key returns the same snapshot.
Deleting the source retracts the published Wiki, scrubs all block content, and records Wiki derivatives in deletion lineage.

limits: The compiler currently covers reviewed screenshot and transcript evidence, confirmed temporal facts, visible conflicts, and one action or no_action; resume, document, URL research, observed outcomes, and professional history are not connected.
No task-scoped Chat context manifest or Chat response is executable yet.
Gold here means the bounded deterministic publication contract passed; it is not field evidence that the brief is maximally useful.
